correctness.rationale: Each face has at most two block supports. For each pair the union of two cone joins has intersection a complete bipartite graph, hence is the suspension of that connected graph. Gluing pair spaces along contractible block simplices over the complete block graph yields one circle per chord and primitive 2-sphere contributions from each pair. Integral Mayer–Vietoris and explicit oriented tetrahedron boundaries give the natural augmentation tensor lattice; 30 independent finite-field homology tests corroborate scope and small cases.
